thread:
ivy: Quick note - users are skipping the hero banner on first run. Can we try a small inline "starter checklist" instead of the full strip?

samir: Agree. Keep it minimal: header + 3 steps + CTA. No carousel.

hana: Copy suggestion: 'Starter checklist — 3 quick steps (≈5 min)' then list items with time estimates. More specific.

liam: A11y: ensure expand/collapse uses aria-expanded and that focus order is logical. Provide skip link.

ivy: Also add a per-user dismiss that persists. Track events: checklist_shown, checklist_dismissed, step_completed.

ux-bot: Experiment queued: ff_starter_checklist_inline (status: draft).
